name: Devon House
sourceName: Jamaica Tourism Board — Devon House Development Limited
ownershipEvidence: The official Devon House page says the mansion was the home of Jamaica’s first Black millionaire, George Stiebel; this is historical-site context, not a present ownership designation.
notes: The Jamaica Tourism Board listing supplies the numbered Kingston address; the official Devon House page independently supplies the same location and customer-facing visitor context.

name: Bob Marley Museum
sourceName: Jamaica Tourism Board — Bob Marley Museum Ltd
ownershipEvidence: The official museum website says the museum is on the site of Bob Marley’s former home; it does not make a business-ownership certification.
notes: The Jamaica Tourism Board listing provides 56 Hope Road and the official museum Instagram displays the same Kingston 6 address in recent post text.

name: National Gallery of Jamaica
address: 12 Ocean Boulevard, Block C, Kingston, Jamaica
sourceName: Jamaica Tourism Board — National Gallery of Jamaica
ownershipEvidence: The Jamaica Tourism Board describes the Gallery as a division of the Institute of Jamaica, Ministry of Culture; no ownership certification is asserted.
notes: Official National Gallery contact information confirms 12 Ocean Boulevard, Block C; tourism-board listing independently describes the museum and its public programmes.

name: Liberty Hall: The Legacy of Marcus Garvey
sourceName: Liberty Hall official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official Liberty Hall site says its journal is dedicated to the history, culture and current affairs of Africa and the African Diaspora; that wording is cultural-programme context, not an ownership designation.
notes: Official contact page provides the numbered King Street address. The official site describes a multimedia museum, reference library, and youth educational outreach.

name: National Museum Jamaica
sourceName: National Museum Jamaica official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official museum calls itself the national agent for collecting, preserving and documenting Jamaica’s material culture.
notes: Official museum contact and home pages consistently give 10 East Street, Kingston.

name: Institute of Jamaica
sourceName: Institute of Jamaica official website
ownershipEvidence: The official site describes the Institute as a cultural, artistic and scientific organisation that promotes the arts and museums and safeguards Jamaican heritage.
notes: Official home page provides the East Street address and describes visitor exhibitions, programmes, libraries, and publications.

name: Kingston Creative
sourceName: Kingston Creative official projects page
ownershipEvidence: Kingston Creative’s official page calls it a registered Jamaican non-profit organisation and an artist-led organisation serving creatives and the Downtown Kingston community.
notes: Official projects page provides the Harbour Street address and describes arts, skills training, entrepreneurship, and resource programmes.

name: Jamaica Cultural Development Commission
sourceName: Jamaica Cultural Development Commission official website
ownershipEvidence: The official about page identifies JCDC as a cultural agency of the Ministry of Culture, Gender, Entertainment and Sport.
notes: Official site provides the Phoenix Avenue address and describes national cultural programmes, local-talent development, and support for community-development agencies.

name: Kingston and St. Andrew Municipal Corporation
sourceName: Kingston and St. Andrew Municipal Corporation official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official site identifies the organisation as the local authority serving Kingston and St. Andrew.
notes: Official contact page provides the Church Street address. Record is a community resource, not a commercial record.

name: Jamaica Chamber of Commerce
address: Richmond Park Great House, 58 Half Way Tree Road, Kingston 10
sourceName: Jamaica Chamber of Commerce official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The Chamber’s official history page says its mission is business connectivity, trade and commerce facilitation, lobbying, advocacy and business support.
notes: Official contact page provides the Richmond Park Great House address. This is an association resource, not evidence that any member is ownership-certified.

name: Jamaica Business Development Corporation
sourceName: Jamaica Business Development Corporation official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official website describes JBDC services for Jamaican entrepreneurs, including programmes, advisory, research, technical, incubation and marketing services.
notes: Official contact page provides the Kingston head-office address. Record is a public-facing business-support resource, not a commercial candidate.

name: Jamaica Library Service
address: 2 Tom Redcam Drive, Kingston 5, Jamaica W.I.
sourceName: Jamaica Library Service official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official contact page describes JLS as an agency of the Ministry of Education providing information, educational and recreational programmes through public and school library networks.
notes: Official contact page provides the Kingston 5 headquarters street address. This record is a public community resource.

name: YouthJamaica
sourceName: YouthJamaica official Facebook page
ownershipEvidence: The official Facebook page calls YouthJamaica the official website for Jamaica’s Youth Innovation Centres, and the official website links youth to scholarships, social services, employment assistance and entrepreneurship information.
notes: Official Facebook page provides the National Heroes Circle address; official YouthJamaica website provides Ministry contact and youth-resource context.

name: Support Jamaica
sourceName: Support Jamaica official contact page
ownershipEvidence: The official site links to the Office of Disaster Preparedness and Emergency Management (ODPEM); it is retained as a community resource without a claim about assistance availability.
notes: Official contact page provides the Haining Road address. Record is a government-linked community resource, not a commercial candidate.

name: Emancipation Park
address: Oxford Road and Knutsford Boulevard, Kingston
sourceName: Kingston and St. Andrew Municipal Corporation — Emancipation Park
ownershipEvidence: The municipal source calls the park “Tribute to Freedom” and describes its freedom-themed public artwork and West African spiritual symbols; this is cultural context, not a demographic or ownership designation.
notes: Official municipal attraction page supplies the cross-street address and points to the park’s official website. It is kept as a cultural/recreation place, not as a commercial record.

name: Bookophilia
sourceName: Bookophilia official Facebook page
notes: Official Facebook page identifies Bookophilia as an indie bookstore/cafe and supplies the Hope Road address. The official Instagram profile independently identifies it as a bookstore/cafe and shows current activity.

name: The Artisan Collective Store
address: Shop 2, 12 Ocean Boulevard, Downtown Kingston, Jamaica
sourceName: Kingston Creative — Artisan Collective Store official project page
ownershipEvidence: Kingston Creative’s official page says the store is a zero-commission retail outlet for Jamaican artisans; this describes the store’s retail purpose, not individual-artisan ownership.
notes: Kingston Creative’s official page gives 12 Ocean Boulevard; the official store Instagram specifies Shop 2 at the same address.

name: Things Jamaican Shopping
sourceName: Things Jamaican Shopping official Facebook page
ownershipEvidence: The official Facebook profile calls the business “Home of Authentic Jamaican Brands”; this is self-description, not a third-party ownership certification.
notes: Official business Facebook profile supplies store category, address, phone, and customer-facing profile.

name: M10 Bar and Grill
address: 6 Vineyard Town Road, Vineyard Town, Kingston, Jamaica
sourceName: Kingston and St. Andrew Municipal Corporation restaurant directory
notes: The municipal restaurant directory provides the Vineyards Town Road address and links the official Facebook page. The official profile identifies the business as a Bar & Grill.

name: One Hundred
sourceName: One Hundred official website
notes: Official website provides the Hope Road address and describes dining and entertainment venues. Record is classified by the restaurant’s customer-facing offering; no gaming-license claim is made.

name: Chilitos Jamexican Restaurant
sourceName: Kingston and St. Andrew Municipal Corporation restaurant directory
notes: Municipal directory supplies discovery and the official restaurant website independently confirms 88 Hope Road, Kingston, cuisine description, phone, and official social accounts.

name: Sweetwood Jerk Joint

notes: Jamaica Travel and Culture supplies the numbered Knutsford Boulevard address and jerk-food description. The business’s official Facebook page was separately inspected as the customer-facing destination.

sourceName: Kurly Kulture official website
notes: Official website describes a Kingston natural-hair salon and provides the Chelsea Avenue address. Routed to regulated_review because beauty/cosmetology is a regulated-service category; no licence or credential is certified.

sourceName: Myers, Fletcher & Gordon official contact page
notes: Official website describes legal support and lists multiple legal practice areas. Routed to regulated_review because legal services are regulated; no attorney admission, licence, or credential is certified.
